facts.business: Sammaan Capital Limited is a retail-focused, technology-led NBFC providing mortgage loans and secured business lending, transitioning to a diversified non-bank financier serving mid- to low-income borrowers across India.

segments.name: Residential mortgages and secured business lending

guidance_or_targets.statement: Promoter holding to increase to 41.24% upon conversion of warrants
Capital adequacy ratio expected to increase to around 29% on pro-forma basis following warrant conversion

auditor.name: NANGIA & CO LLP and M Verma & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on change in business model for identified pool of loan exposures and investments, reclassification, sale to ARC and resulting losses presented as Exceptional Item of Rs 6,499.17 crores and Other Comprehensive Loss of Rs 652.78 crores; Management Overlay recognised over and above ECL provision based on assessment of evolving macroeconomic conditions, geopolitical developments, sectoral risks, model limitations and other emerging uncertainties.

facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of the Act, where applicable, and details have been disclosed in the notes to the Standalone Financial Statements, as required by the applicable accounting standards.
